title: Secure Randomness and Tokens knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which approach best demonstrates understanding of “Secure Randomness and Tokens”?
options: Skip tests because a short example ran once.
Use Secure Randomness and Tokens deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case.
Assume Ruby automatically guarantees every business rule and external system behavior.
Replace all built-in features with a third-party framework regardless of the task.

questions.explanation: Use Secure Randomness and Tokens deliberately: state the expected behavior, apply it in a small example, and verify a boundary case. The alternatives overstate Ruby guarantees or encourage unverified behavior.
